name: Hard Boiled & Wild Cat
original_name: ハードボイルド&ワイルドキャット
source:
Samonji Mumyo is a hit man turned detective. While following up on a request to investigate Imperial Heavy Industries he gets caught up in an incident involving his past.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ038149.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Samonji Mumyo是一名从杀手转行的侦探。在追查Imperial Heavy Industries的一项委托时，他卷入了一桩与自己过去有关的事件。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ038149.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
